post_text: Hey everyone, just wanted to share something that happened to me last night partly because I never thought it would happen to me and partly to remind us all to stay alert and safe out there running I wouldn’t normally post something like this but I feel like it’s important to share I was out doing what I love doing and had stuck to roads I know really well, it wasn’t even dark yet and there was plenty of people and cars around and a fully blacked out Mercedes started following me. It drove past slowly, kept circling and came back past me four times in 10 minutes. The windows were so heavily tinted I couldn’t see who was driving or anything inside at all. Mercedes-Benz E-class, registration KR17 XCB. I don’t get spooked easily and after the fourth time I ran as fast as I could to the Why not inn pub who were amazing and made sure I was safe. I’m usually so careful, I plan my route, stick to places I know, stay aware… but this just shows it can happen to anyone, anywhere. Please look out for yourselves and each other ✨If you can run with someone I don’t think I will be running solo for a long time ✨Keep to busy and well‑lit roads ✨If something feels off trust your gut, head straight for an open business, pub or house where there are people ✨Report anything that makes you feel uneasy it could be nothing but it’s always best to be safe ✨ Always let people know where your going and share you live location
